scope: Exact prior/current comparisons for the rewritten opening; these are scholarly comparisons, not independent priority certification.
common_infinite_run_convention: Full inverse BFGS; arbitrary SPD initialization; fixed 0<c1<c2<1; differentiable accepted iterates with nonzero gradients; positive Armijo–weak-Wolfe steps. This matches Guo–Lewis Definition2.1 for infinite sequences.

comparisons.prior_result_or_question: Probability-one nonbreakdown/nontermination, Clarke-stationary cluster points, R-linear all-trial values, and conditional spectral-subspace identification for locally Lipschitz semialgebraic bounded-sublevel objectives.
comparisons.current_answer: Deterministic convex sufficient conditions and deterministic failures for one exact search.
comparisons.strict_difference: Exceptional initial points and nonsemialgebraic accumulation constructions establish neither positive-probability failure nor a resolution of the complete challenge.

art:centered.review: Finite convex F, minimizer star, convex locally C1,1 psi on open convex U, finite convex degree-one gamma, exact centered representation on U, compact entire initial sublevel contained in U. Article open-convex U is a specialization of the formal open-set contract. No separate summand minima. Distance follows the recorded compact-value theorem; uniqueness only for iterates. Article uses its complete inward-Taylor proof, whereas the old principal implementation uses the proved cocoercivity correction bound.

art:homogeneous.review: Finite convex degree-one homogeneous objective in positive finite dimension; genuine coercivity, arbitrary actual run. Origin uniqueness and all compact sublevels are derived, not assumed on the run. Article proves this compact specialization using exact inward homogeneity; full noncompact dichotomy is explicitly companion-only.

art:polyhedral.review: Canonical existing statement is input once in local.tex. Finite closed full-dimensional polyhedral cover of local U; separate open extension domains containing U∩Pi, extensions only locally C1,1 and need not convex. Discard nonincident cells then shrink before using radial derivative equality. Unique minimizer and whole original-objective convexity retained.

art:planar-max.review: Finite convex F:R²→R with unique minimizer; exact local finite maximum of convex C² branches; only original-active gradients affinely independent and strictly positive optimal weights. Sufficiently low global sublevel frontier strictness retained, or common positive branch Hessian bound as proved sufficient alternative. Objective-only epsilon precedes run/SPD/valid constants, strict initial threshold. Local subgradient formula proved via finite directional max, separation and extension of supporting inequalities by convexity.
